text: Compared with the earlier promise, the difference is smaller than it seems. Isaac is the child of the covenant, the one through whom the nations are to be blessed; yet the promise made in him becomes here the matter of a test. Abraham speaks a single word, _hineni_, "here I am," three times: to God, to Isaac, to the angel. It never means the same thing twice. Each time he says it, the word costs Abraham more than it did before.
